feeds.title: Penelope Guzman

Freelance writer & virtual assistant - Homeschooling homesteading mom of 9- Blogging to help you balance diapers and deadlines & boost your productivity.

feeds.title: Mom Wife Wine
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, a wife and stay-at-home mom of five. Follow my family on all things parenting, marriage, life, and kids. The goal of Mom. Wife. Wine. is to give other moms inspiration and relief from everyday life. Whether it be through a craft, activity, printable, wine review, or recipe, I hope to relate to other moms like myself.

feeds.title: Work from Home Happiness Blog
feeds.description: Ashlee Anderson is a Certified Professional Career Coach (CPCC) specializing in remote work. She's on a mission to help job seekers ditch their daily commute in favor of telecommuting. Follow the blog for career-related tips and tricks for remote workers. I tackle topics like job searching, career ideas, and professional purpose to find the right fit remote job you deserve. And once you're working remotely, you can read up on work-life balance, time management, mindset and motivation so you can thrive in a virtual environment.

feeds.title: Working Momspiration
feeds.description: Working Momspiration is a place for moms to learn how to start their own blog, make money with side hustles or their own online businesses. Because we know how hard it can be to work from home with kids, you will get awesome productivity and stay-at-home mom tips.

feeds.title: Beth Behrendt Blog
